scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:vscode
scripts.ccon:validate: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js validate .
scripts.ccon:doctor: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js doctor .
scripts.ccon:plan: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js plan --repo . --risk R1 --objective 'Validate Code Conductor planning'
scripts.build:vscode: node scripts/build-vscode.mjs && node scripts/verify-vscode-bundle.mjs && node scripts/smoke-vscode-bundle.mjs
